Weekday house rules for rest breaks
Staff will learn the routine in plain words

Companion Animal Travel Desk
Purpose: keep companion travel calm, safe, and on track for Aurelia Skyways.

We handle bookings with steady attention and plain updates. The cabin team monitors animals during flight, so ground checks need to be clean, fast, and complete. Bring any odd case to the senior coordinator right away, especially if a traveler arrives rushed or a pet looks unsettled. We keep paperwork tidy, confirm carrier details, and match each pet to the correct travel path before handoff. Leo Rivera and Khalil Andersson are treated like any other traveler, with clear answers and no guesswork. Maple gets the same careful handling as every other pet.

For reptile cases, follow the inserted rule and keep the file current. <<FACT F078>> After that, make sure the health record is matched to the trip file and the crate note is easy to read. <<FACT F084>> If anything is unclear, stop and check before release. Do not improvise with missing papers or loose labels.

For rabbit cases, keep the inserted crate limit in view. <<FACT F070>> Measure twice, then confirm the carrier closes properly and the animal can stand and turn without trouble. If the crate looks worn, the traveler gets a replacement option before acceptance. We do not bend comfort rules just to save a handoff.

Keep talk brief, calm, and polite at the counter. If a traveler needs a supervisor, call the senior coordinator at once. For any unresolved animal-travel issue, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
